patchNotes: Added lightweight VX1000, MK1 Death Lens, and Clean Fisheye presets to Replay Camera Lab, with adjustable lens shape, optical crop, framing, vignette, and replay keyframes. Updated Peg Sparks to the current visuals and tuning, with reliable bundle verification and cleaner loading. Fixed empty trick-slot binding and bike-stance option saving, added Reset buttons to the runtime vehicle-tuning inspector, and improved the debug map loader's offline start.
